leftEvidence.title: The heavens are torn open over Jesus

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus comes from Nazareth, is baptized by John, and immediately sees the heavens torn open and the Spirit descending.
points.right: John calls Jesus God’s Lamb, says Jesus ranks before him, and explains that the purpose of his water baptism was Israel’s recognition.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: A voice directly addresses Jesus as beloved Son and names divine pleasure.
points.right: John testifies that he saw the Spirit descend and remain, receiving that sign from the one who sent him.

payload.posture: Mark narrates the event; John’s Gospel reports the baptizer’s sign and testimony.

rightEvidence.title: John identifies Jesus by a descending and remaining Spirit

payload.tension: John’s source omits the water act while expanding recognition, remaining, Lamb, and testimony language.
payload.title: Narrated baptism and retrospective testimony
